title: Verify stored source bytes
responsibility: Read exact Git blob bytes and derive content bindings for ordinary files or Git LFS pointers.

inputs.name: hubRaw.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubRaw.entry
inputs.description: Tree entry naming the path and expected Git blob hash.

inputs.name: hubMaterializedHash.raw
inputs.description: Raw Git blob bytes, possibly containing a Git LFS pointer.

inputs.name: hubMaterializedHash.expected
inputs.description: Optional expected SHA-256; null skips that comparison.

inputs.name: hubBlobProfile.path
inputs.description: File path to hash into the profile name.

inputs.name: hubBlobProfile.sha
inputs.description: Git blob identity to append to the profile name.

outputs.name: hubRaw
outputs.description: Verified raw bytes from prefetched metadata, cache or source; compares the Git SHA-1 blob hash before returning.

outputs.name: hubMaterializedHash
outputs.description: Content SHA-256, byte size and lfs flag. Ordinary bytes are hashed directly; LFS requires the exact supported pointer format and a safe integer size no greater than 50000000.

outputs.name: hubBlobProfile
outputs.description: Profile string combining kind, SHA-256 of path and supplied blob ID.
